verdict.rationale: Pigment is a SaaS planning platform that advertises "open APIs" and an Audit Trail API, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, the evidence never documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. The llms.txt docs index and the MCP server are adjacent features and do not count as an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
